description_long:
Pinnacle Credit Repair is a credit repair company listed in the CreditDoc directory. The company's website was not reachable during our review, so we could not independently confirm current products, pricing, licensing status, or operating hours. This profile page exists so consumers researching Pinnacle Credit Repair can find the contact record on CreditDoc.

Because we could not verify the site, this page does not describe specific loan products, rates, or service details. Consumers considering Pinnacle Credit Repair should contact the company directly to confirm what services are currently offered and at what cost, and to request written disclosures for any product before signing.

Credit repair companies must comply with the federal Credit Repair Organizations Act (CROA). Look up the company on the CFPB Consumer Response Profile and confirm they don't charge upfront fees before signing anything.

pros: Some consumers report successful removal of collections and negative items leading to significant score improvements
Offers dispute services across all three major credit bureaus
New York-based operation provides accessibility for tri-state area consumers
cons: Not BBB accredited with consumer complaints on file
Multiple reviews describe escalating costs beyond initial price quotes, suggesting potential bait-and-switch pricing
At least one consumer reported the business to FTC, BBB, and NY Attorney General for deceptive practices
No transparent pricing published online, making comparison shopping impossible
PayPal reportedly flagged the business under its credit repair payment policies
best_for: Consumers should exercise extreme caution. Established alternatives like The Credit People, Credit Saint, or Sky Blue Credit offer transparent pricing and stronger accountability.
services: Dispute letter preparation and filing with Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion
Collection account dispute and removal attempts
Credit report monitoring during dispute process
typical_results_timeline: Results vary by individual situation. Contact the provider to discuss expected timelines for your specific needs.
